articles.title: Why M&S director Kathryn Turner is the ultimate ‘Gay Halloween’ costume idea
articles.summary: Product development boss at Marks & Spencer inspires niche outfits after unexpected success on social media. She is not the most likely viral star. But with 310,000 followers on TikTok and 270,000 on Instagram, Marks & Spencer Food’s director of product development, Kathryn Turner, has suddenly…
body: Turner is part of Marks & Spencer’s wider social media strategy implemented in 2020 as a way of attracting younger shoppers. Instead of using traditional influencers, M&S now champions 100 of its own employees on TikTok.

Turner, who launched her account in May, now regularly receives more than 1m likes on her videos, with celebrities including Nigella Lawson and Stormzy among her followers. Part of the appeal is Turner’s insider knowledge and expertise: she has worked at M&S since 1995.

The content creator Liam Gleed has been posting videos of himself as Turner in the run-up to Halloween and plans to wear the costume this weekend. “To be very real, I love a sweet treat and I work close to an M&S so I follow her socials to find out what snacks I’ll be getting every Friday at work,” he says. “The more niche you go for Halloween, the better. Why go as basic characters when you can dress as your current fixation or icons of the internet?”

articles.title: I wrote a book about death. Here’s what people really think about dying
articles.summary: In the eight years since my graphic novel on death published, I’ve learned readers of all ages want to talk about loss and preserve their family’s stories. Becoming an author in my late 50s was unexpected, the result of my daughter Hallie’s own existential anxiety in her early 20s.
body: Fearing my untimely demise, she begged me to write down advice that would cover all of life’s bases going forward. I agreed, but put the project off for years; it wasn’t until she cornered me with a laptop on vacation that I gave in. She asked countless questions, and I found, to my surprise, that I had plenty to say. Hallie helped shape the manuscript, and then spent a year painting its warmly emotional gouache illustrations.

Our graphic novel, What to Do When I’m Gone: A Mother’s Wisdom to Her Daughter, was published in 2018. Though marketed for mothers and daughters, it holds my advice to all three of my children on moving forward after I die. Included are notes on grief and loss and life, plus a few recipes – not because I’m a great cook, but because food is so integral to family heritage. The book is a lighthearted, emotional and highly illustrated ode to moving forward and living life fully while grieving the loss of a parent or, really, anyone you love.

What we’ve learned in the eight years since its release is that readers of all ages have a deep hunger to know more about their parents’ backgrounds, beliefs and values, including around grief and loss.

articles.title: Ghost in the machine: how AI is haunting the search for the supernatural
articles.summary: Ghost hunting has changed in recent years due to AI chatbots, and paranormal enthusiasts are concerned. Ghost hunting is a tech-heavy pursuit. When Amy Waine and Jarrad Cutting investigate haunted locations, they’re loaded up with software of their own design, such as an app that assigns signals…
body: But for others in the ghost hunting world, AI is an unwelcome presence. Since the release of ChatGPT in 2022, AI-generated ghost stories and images of the supernatural have flooded online spaces, so much so that popular forums like the r/Nosleep subreddit, meant for scary stories, have implemented a strict policy against AI-generated material.

Waine and Cutting claim their app can generate images depicting the supernatural, using signals from a phone’s built-in magnetometer, identifying words and phrases in those signals, and then running them through an image generator.

Fellow paranormal enthusiasts can post the images they generate to a feed and comment on other users’ pictures. Since its release in 2023, Seer has become a regular part of their onscreen work. In a recent video on their Amy’s Crypt YouTube channel, the pair sat in a carefully selected location in the Winchester Mystery House while running GhostTube Seer.

articles.title: What Makes the New La Roche-Posay UV Defense Sunscreen Special? BEMT
articles.summary: The new La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVDefense sunscreen offers advanced UVA protection with a PA++++ rating and broad-spectrum SPF 50 against harmful UVA and UVB rays. Here, Vogue puts it to the test.
body: Ears perked up in beauty communities across America when the FDA finally approved the first new UV filter in 20 years; and apparently, brands couldn’t wait to introduce bemotrizinol (BEMT) into the market. One such pioneer is La Roche-Posay who, earlier this month, debuted its Anthelios UV Defense Sunscreen SPF50, powered by the intelligent sunscreen filter.

That’s not to say that BEMT alone makes an SPF feel better to wear: “Existing FDA-approved filters can be combined to achieve broad-spectrum protection,” board-certified dermatologist Sejal Shah, MD says. “However, BEMT gives formulators another way to achieve that protection, with potentially useful advantages in stability and formulation flexibility.” By expanding the formulator’s toolbox, it allows brands to create products that are as effective in protecting skin as they are comfortable and elegant to wear.
points: The new La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVDefense sunscreen offers advanced UVA protection with a PA++++ rating and broad-spectrum SPF 50 against harmful UVA and UVB rays.

articles.title: The Brilliantly Easy French Trick for the Most Tender Pot Roast
articles.summary: I think pot roast might be the perfect meal. It starts with a tough (read: cheaper) cut of meat, yet becomes meltingly tender with time. There’s no need to prepare extra side dishes, because the veggies cook with the beef in the flavorful gravy.
body: With so much going for pot roast, it’s no surprise that I’ve tried countless flavor variations — from Italian-seasoned to harissa-spiced. Regardless of the seasonings used or the vegetables added, the process of braising remained the same. But when my Dutch oven lid went missing, I discovered a classic French tip that made preparing my favorite braised beef dishes even easier and more delicious.

Covering a pot with a cartouche or a parchment paper lid is a classic French technique used for braises. Braising involves quickly searing meat over high heat, then simmering, covered, low and slow in liquid until tender. This keeps the meat moist as the tough collagen transforms into gelatin. It’s important to cover the meat to control the evaporation and keep the meat partially submerged throughout the hours-long cooking process.

articles.title: I Tried 5 Methods to Clean My Greasy Wood Cabinets, and This 2-Minute Trick Is Ridiculously Effective
articles.summary: Even if you don’t cook regularly, you know how greasy the surfaces in your kitchen can get — especially the cabinets. And kitchens have a lot of cabinets. Between testing recipes for work and cooking for my family, I try to stay on top of daily tasks.
body: To cut down on the time and effort I spend on it, I tested five popular methods for how to clean kitchen cabinets to see which one worked the best. Here is the one that won.
The best way to clean greasy cabinets is to scrub them with a soft rag or non-abrasive sponge and a mixture of Dawn dish soap and warm water, then wipe away any residue with a clean, damp sponge.
Note: Be sure to always check the product’s instructions before cleaning your cabinets. Spot-test if you’re unsure about your cabinets’ varnish or stain.

How it went: This option is definitely the way to go for greasy kitchen cabinets. I put a little Dawn into a bowl and filled it with warm water, then got to scrubbing. My greasiest cabinets were cleaned with almost zero effort as the classic dish soap cut right through the grime. I then went back with a clean, damp sponge to wipe up the soap residue, which didn’t add too much extra time. This was clearly the winning method, and I’m excited about how well it worked. I’ll go back to it time and time again!

articles.title: 9 Best Sunscreens for Sensitive Skin, According to Dermatologists
articles.summary: The best sunscreen for sensitive skin delivers SPF protection without any of the irritation. Shop 9 dermatologist-approved mineral and chemical sunscreens for sensitive, reactive, or eczema-prone skin.
body: The rules have changed when it comes to choosing the best sunscreens for sensitive skin. In the past, mineral or nontoxic was the way to go for those prone to breakouts or irritation. These days, the playing field has widened considerably, with gentle chemical formulas and K-beauty options designed to pamper and protect the skin.

“Overall, sunscreens for sensitive skin are improving both in terms of efficacy and cosmetic elegance,” says Marisa Garshick, MD, a board-certified dermatologist in Manhattan and New Jersey. “Newer mineral formulations have been developed that are lightweight, absorb easily, and are not as likely to leave behind a white cast.” Plus, the newly FDA-approved SPF filter bemotrizinol ( BEMT ) has expanded the options for those with sensitive skin who prefer a chemical formula.

articles.title: Janelle Monáe on Transforming Into ‘Phish Boy’ for Halloween
articles.summary: “I love that space where something can be beautiful, strange, and a little unsettling all at once,” says Janelle Monáe of her 2026 Halloween costume.
body: Every year, there are two celebrities who go all-out for Halloween: Heidi Klum and Janelle Monáe. You could say they are both spooky season royalty: Klum hosts her infamous New York City “Heidiween” bash, while Monáe leads “Wondaween” in Los Angeles. “I went into Halloween season feeling so excited to uncover a new character, and ready to be with my community of fellow Wondaweenies,” Monáe tells Vogue. “Creativity and community really make me the happiest, and I love that this time of year gives us all more permission to step outside of ourselves and explore a different part of our imaginations.”

Staged last night, this year, Monáe’s Wondaween had a “Creature Carnival” theme. Guests were encouraged to dress up as their best circus-inspired freakshow attractions. “I’m always asking myself, ‘what haven’t I done yet?’ ‘What new world can be imagined and built?’” says Monáe. So what did that mean for Monáe’s very own, highly-anticipated costume? “I love the idea of bringing a creature into the world that people might not know what to make of at first,” she says. Enter… Phish Boy.

articles.title: Japanese Sweet Potato Chaat
articles.summary: Top slow-roasted sweet potatoes with tamarind concentrate, green chutney, fresh onions, tomatoes, and cilantro for a chaat-inspired appetizer.
body: Every cuisine has a sauce that’s an absolute essential—a ride or die, if you will. For South Asian food, this is a cilantro mint green chutney. It brings a punchy, herb-packed burst of flavor that goes with pretty much everything. This recipe combines cilantro, mint, and just the right amount of heat from green chiles, creating a balance of spice and freshness. Lime juice adds brightness, while cumin, sugar, and chaat masala add complexity. Use this as a zesty topping for your favorite dish or as a base for pani puri water (just add 1½ cups [360 ml] of water and strain), or make it creamy with yogurt or sour cream to use for spreading and dipping.

articles.title: At This Ultra-Private New Hotel in Florence, You Can Live Like a Modern Medici
articles.summary: A family-owned pied-à-terre inside a 15th-century palazzo in buzzy Oltrarno, La Réserve Firenze offers Trattoria Cammillo room service and the keys to the city’s best-kept secrets.
body: On a balmy September evening that felt like summer’s last gasp, I boarded a barchetto —the Florentine equivalent of a Venetian gondola—for a little cruise on the Arno. It was quiet on the river, far more serene than on the Ponte Vecchio, where the clamorous tourist crowds threatened to spill over the balustrades. The noise dimmed as the bridge went over our heads, then came the pop of a Champagne bottle. I accepted a flute from Grégory Marciano as his wife Olivia doled out cherry tomatoes, plucked from the gardens of their villa, an erstwhile holiday home of the Gucci family on the outskirts of Florence.
points: A family-owned pied-à-terre inside a 15th-century palazzo in buzzy Oltrarno, La Réserve Firenze offers Trattoria Cammillo room service and the keys to the city’s best-kept secrets.
